title: Hedda
actors: Glenda Jackson, Timothy West, Peter Eyre
plot: Henrik Ibsen's enduring drama about a Nordic femme fatale, a neurotic, controlling, strong-willed woman who is nonetheless alluring to the males in her town. She is a solitary woman in a society held together by kinship and class....
awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 1 win & 4 nominations total
